trecho: When you use our Services, we collect personal data that is included in the input, text, documents, files, images, audio, video, or other content that you provide to our Services ("Prompts"), and the output, text, documents, files, images, audio, video, or other content that our Services generate in response to a Prompt ("Completions").
justificativa_juridica: Discrimina minuciosamente as categorias de inputs (Prompts) e outputs (Completions) processadas durante o uso do modelo de inteligência artificial (art. 6º da LGPD).

trecho: We will not use your Prompts and Completions from our commercial or paid services to train our models, unless you explicitly agree or direct us to do so.
justificativa_juridica: Garante que inputs e saídas dos usuários comerciais não são usados para treinamento de LLM sem autorização explícita, assegurando transparência e privacidade do usuário.

trecho: We may disclose personal data to vendors, service providers, and other partners who provide services to us, including: cloud infrastructure, web hosting, and storage providers; IT and cybersecurity providers; payment processing and fraud detection providers
justificativa_juridica: Identifica com clareza as classes setoriais de subprocessadores e operadores contratados (hospedagem, segurança e pagamentos), atendendo ao art. 9º, V da LGPD.

trecho: We may disclose your personal data if we believe in good faith that such disclosure is necessary to: comply with relevant laws or to respond to subpoenas, warrants, or other legal process served on us;
justificativa_juridica: Divulgação legalmente fundamentada restrita ao atendimento de intimações, ordens judiciais ou cumprimento de dever legal (art. 7º, II da LGPD).

trecho: Data Subject’s Rights. LGPD grants certain rights regarding your personal data, which differ from the GDPR, UK GDPR, and other laws in certain respects. These rights include: Confirmation of the existence of the processing; Access to personal data; Correction of incomplete, inaccurate or out-of-date data; Anonymization, blocking or elimination of unnecessary or excessive data;
justificativa_juridica: Seção específica para o Brasil que enumera explicitamente todos os direitos assegurados pela LGPD ao titular brasileiro (art. 18).

trecho: Revocation of consent. To exercise your rights, please contact us by emailing dpo@anthropic.com or through our Privacy Request Form.
justificativa_juridica: Disponibiliza formulário específico e canal com o DPO para solicitação de revogação de consentimento e atendimento a direitos (art. 8º da LGPD).

trecho: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which we collected it, including to satisfy any legal, accounting, or reporting requirements, to establish or defend legal claims, or for fraud prevention and safety purposes.
justificativa_juridica: Estipula política de retenção atrelada à finalidade específica, obrigações contábeis e defesa em demandas jurídicas (art. 16 da LGPD).

trecho: We have implemented technical and organizational measures designed to protect your personal data from loss, misuse, and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, or destruction.
justificativa_juridica: Afirma genericamente a implementação de salvaguardas técnicas e organizacionais, sem explicitar os métodos criptográficos aplicados ou planos de resposta a incidentes (art. 46 da LGPD).

trecho: Our Services are not directed to children under the age of 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under the age of 18. If you become aware that a child has provided us with personal data, please contact us.
justificativa_juridica: Veda expressamente o uso por qualquer indivíduo menor de 18 anos, estabelecendo padrão rigoroso de proteção a crianças e adolescentes (art. 14 da LGPD).

trecho: In the case of Brazil, we will rely on standard contractual clauses (SCCs) for our international data transfers as adopted by our group companies or in an adequacy decision. These SCCs have been approved by the Brazilian Data Protection Authority (ANPD)
justificativa_juridica: Submete formalmente as transferências de dados brasileiros às Cláusulas-Padrão Contratuais aprovadas pela Autoridade Nacional de Proteção de Dados (art. 33, II da LGPD).

trecho: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will provide notice through our Services, by email, or other communication, prior to the changes becoming effective.
justificativa_juridica: Compromisso de aviso prévio ('prior to the changes becoming effective') via e-mail ou na plataforma antes da vigência de alterações materiais (art. 9º, §2º da LGPD).

trecho: If you live in Brazil, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Brazilian Data Protection Authority (ANPD). If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our practices, please contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@anthropic.com.
justificativa_juridica: Identifica o canal do Encarregado (dpo@anthropic.com) e informa expressamente o direito de peticionar perante a ANPD (art. 41 da LGPD).
